content:
After a preview at the May I/O 2026 conference, the macOS version of Gemini has officially launched advanced voice control features.

Google positions this feature as enabling users to "have natural conversations in any window on the desktop," bringing two main capabilities.

The first is "Smart Voice Input," which can "transcribe spoken content into clean, polished text." Gemini automatically removes filler words like "um" and "uh," and accounts for mid-sentence corrections to accurately capture what the user intends to express.

The formatted text will be automatically inserted at the current cursor position, offering an experience similar to the Gboard Rambler keyboard's voice-to-text feature, which is soon to debut on Gemini Intelligence phones.

The other capability goes beyond simple transcription, able to understand the current screen content to perform complex tasks. This optional feature requires users to enable Gemini's reasoning capabilities in the app settings.

  • Capture and organise information: Mark local files, images, or documents on your desktop, then tell Gemini what you need. For example, you can say: "Read these vet records and email a summary of my dog's medical history to the boarding centre."
  • Write and revise text: Mark text anywhere on the screen, then use voice to instantly rewrite, adjust the tone, and place the revised version precisely where needed. You can try saying: "Rewrite these notes into an executive summary and add a TL;DR at the beginning."
  • Generate and edit images: When brainstorming concepts or planning an itinerary, you can use voice to generate visuals; or reference existing designs on your desktop and request quick updates. You can try saying: "Generate a dark mode version based on this illustration."

No matter where you are in macOS, long-press the Fn key to launch, or click the newly added screen-sharing button at the end of the "Ask Gemini" prompt. Gemini will display a floating capsule icon with sound wave animation at the bottom of the screen.

Please ensure the macOS version of Gemini is updated to the latest version (1.88). This new voice feature is rolling out globally, currently supporting English, with more languages to be added "later".
